sections.Profile:
FJ, released by A. Hankin & Co. in 1978, is an Australian solid-state pinball machine themed after the iconic Holden FJ automobile from the 1950s. The game features two flippers, three pop bumpers, three kick-out holes, and two rollunder spinners. The artwork, created by Mike Eggleston, captures the nostalgic essence of the FJ Holden, a car synonymous with Australian culture in the 1960s and 1970s. As one of the early pinball machines produced by Hankin, FJ holds a special place in the history of Australian pinball manufacturing.

- Manufacturer: A. Hankin & Co.
- Years made: 1978
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
- Display: Alphanumeric
- Players: 4
- Tags: Nostalgia, Licensed, 1970s, Solid State, Cars
